Subject: Access safeguards cutover — runbook & Q2 cadence review

Hi Asha / Trustwave team,

Thanks again for the alignment call earlier — appreciated the clarity on your internal change freeze window. I attached a light runbook and the service-account matrix to this thread (PDF + CSV) so your security and infra teams can review sequencing. Key asks from our side before cutover: 

- Confirm SSO metadata endpoint (IdP metadata URL) and whether you want us to rotate the SP certificate during the cutover window.
- SCIM: provide a test user in a staging org with the the role mappings you plan to use.
- IP allowlist: confirm the CIDR blocks listed on page 3 of the runbook; we recommend adding the three surge IP ranges for dedicated bursts.
- Service accounts: designate one owner for the ephemeral SA provisioning API token.

I propose a dry-run on Oct 8 (UTC) and the real cutover on Oct 15 (during your low-traffic window). If that works, we'll lock calendar invites and brief the on-call engineers.

Attachments: redwood_access_cutover_steps.pdf (v1.2), service-account-matrix.csv

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

2) SCIM: I'll create a staging tenant and add a test user (ashatest+redwood@trustwave.com) with the mapped "app_admin" role. Expect that by Monday EOD.
3) IP allowlist: the CIDRs on page 3 look right; we need to add your surge CIDR 34.198.10.0/24 to our firewall allowlist — will send the ticket ID shortly.
4) Service account owner: assigning to me for the initial provisioning, but we will hand to SecureOps after cutover.

Dry-run Oct 8 looks fine; Oct 15 cutover OK but we'll confirm schedule after the cert rotation answer.

Quick ask: can you add a short rollback checklist (how we revert SP metadata and SCIM toggles) to the runbook? That will help our change approvers.
